name: mlsys-lab
displayName: mlsys-lab — CUDA, C++ and LLM-systems exercises, auto-graded
description: Graded exercises in CUDA, C++, Python and LLM systems. Write real CUDA kernels with no NVIDIA GPU: a software GPU counts warps, coalescing transactions, shared-memory bank conflicts and divergence. Deterministic gates, identical score on any machine.
